facts.function: classifies/separates pulverized coal by particle size in a mill

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8474 machinery for sorting, screening, separating mineral substances in solid form; solid mineral fuels (coal) are included
GRI 6: 8474.10 sorting, screening, separating or washing machines; stationary

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of separating machines; the description names a classifier as a machine, not a part
furnace burners; the classifier is not a burner, it sizes the pulverized fuel
centrifuges/filters for liquids and gases; here solids are separated by size

missing_facts: Whether it is imported as a complete machine or only as a retrofit part
classification.rationale: A dynamic classifier separates particles by size, which heading 8474 covers as separating machinery for solid mineral substances including solid fuels; stationary line assumed. No on-point ruling was found.
